caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a human figure standing on a decorated rectangular base. The figure is wearing a long brown robe with yellow, gold, and blue-grey accents, and a yellow rope-like belt. The robe features a hood, brown sleeves with darker cuffs, and a blue section visible at the bottom near the feet. The figure's feet are visible in brown sandals. One arm is bent upward at the elbow with the hand raised, while the other arm is extended outward with the palm up. The figure has short black hair and is adorned with a circular yellow and red halo or headdress positioned behind the head. The rectangular base is primarily light yellow-green with red, yellow, and green decorative floral patterns on the sides and front. The number "37" is printed in the lower left corner of the drawing. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Plate 37: Saint Anthony: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
